715273.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have four customers with open invoices on today's date, named "10 Trucking" (customer A), "2 Trucking" (customer B), "A-1 Towing" (customer C) and "a1 towing" (customer D). Their names differ by a number, a dash or capitals.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name 10 Trucking, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice for customer A: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  4. Make customer B: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name 2 Trucking, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  5. Make invoice for customer B: Same way as invoice for customer A, on customer B's page: Fixed Line Total 100.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  6. Make customer C: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name A-1 Towing, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  7. Make invoice for customer C: Same way as invoice for customer A, on customer C's page: Fixed Line Total 100.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  8. Make customer D: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name a1 towing, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  9. Make invoice for customer D: Same way as invoice for customer A, on customer D's page: Fixed Line Total 100.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
715273.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The customer name column (the first column) is marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Step 2:

  • All four customers are listed, reading from top to bottom customer A, then customer B, then customer C, then customer D (other customers may sit between them).
  • "10 Trucking" comes before "2 Trucking" because names compare character by character.
  • "A-1 Towing" comes before "a1 towing" because capitals are ignored and the dash compares as a character.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R1: “A/R Summary opens with customers in name order, A to Z; A/P Summary opens with vendors in name order, A to Z.”
  • S1-R2: “Name order compares names ignoring capitals, in plain character order: digits and punctuation compare as characters, so "10 Trucking" comes before "2 Trucking" and "A-1 Towing" before "a1 towing". Names that start with a punctuation mark follow the same order: "#1 Diesel", "-1 Diesel", "10 Trucking", "@Home Towing".”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”

Last checked against build v26.45.4-f3d3d2d (staging) on 11/14/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p1-a-r-aging-summary-opens-a-to-z.png: figure "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-summary-date-only.png: figure "A/R Aging Summary as it opens today" (Production (before)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Customer name order the way QuickBooks sorts ("10 Trucking" before "2 Trucking"), marked on the Customer header. S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R4, S1-R7, S1-R8." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z")
  • "Customers come back in no set order, and no column header can be clicked to sort." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary as it opens today")

715312.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents on today's date (invoices, credit memos and deposits) in the "31-60 days past due" and "1-30 days past due" buckets, at least two in each with different open balances and dates, so the re-sort can be seen.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report so that two buckets are expanded: "31-60 days past due" and "1-30 days past due"; the other three are collapsed.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 400.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type the date 70 days before today in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  4. Make invoice 2: Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 250.00; type the date 80 days before today in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  5. Make invoice 3: Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 300.00; type the date 40 days before today in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  6. 715316.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure the report has more than 30 customers with open documents on today's date and on yesterday's date, at both locations.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with open documents at both locations.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Locations to use: Use "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" as location A (in A to Z order it comes before Lethbridge) and "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" as location B. Start at location A: if the top bar shows another location, click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Change Location, then "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919". To work at location B, switch to "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" the same way, and switch back to "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" when you are done.
  3. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  4. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  5. Make invoice 2: While switched to location B (see the Locations to use item): Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 200.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the report has open invoices, credit memos and deposits in at least three aging buckets on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group collapsed.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  4. Make invoice 2: Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 200.00; type the date 45 days before today in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  5. Make invoice 3: Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 300.00; type the date 75 days before today in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  6. Make credit memo 1: On customer A's page open the Invoices tab and click Issue Credit. Type the date 20 days before today in Credit Date, type 50.00 in Amount, click Issue Store Credit (not Issue Refund), type a Reason, then click Issue Credit.
  7. Make deposit 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, click Save, and close the New Line window. Open the Finance tab and click Add Deposit; in Create Deposit pick a Payment Method and type 41.00 in Deposit Amount, then click Record Deposit. Open the Lines tab and click New Line; in the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 1.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Leave Invoice Date as today, click Create Invoice, and reload the page (F5) when the New Customer Payment window opens. The invoice is paid from the deposit, and the rest, 40.00, stays as an unused deposit dated today.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Locations to use: Use "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" as location A (in A to Z order it comes before Lethbridge) and "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" as location B. Start at location A: if the top bar shows another location, click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Change Location, then "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919". To work at location B, switch to "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" the same way, and switch back to "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" when you are done.
  3. Location C: Use "ZZAUTOTEST V1R-87 Location C" as location C: it is in the Change Location list (the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Change Location) and the reports already show open documents there.
  4. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  5. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  6. Make invoice 2: While switched to location B (see the Locations to use item): Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 200.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  7. Make invoice 1 for customer A: Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 100.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  8. Make customer B: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer B, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  9. Make invoice 1 for customer B: Same way as invoice 1, on customer B's page: Fixed Line Total 100.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  10. Make invoice 2 for customer B: While switched to location B (see the Locations to use item): Same way as invoice 1, on customer B's page: Fixed Line Total 200.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.

Preconditions

  • Have a customer with an unused credit memo A and an unused deposit A at your current location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.

  • Leave the report with that customer ticked and every bucket expanded.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make credit memo A: On customer A's page open the Invoices tab and click Issue Credit. Type today's date in Credit Date, type 50.00 in Amount, click Issue Store Credit (not Issue Refund), type a Reason, then click Issue Credit.
  4. Make deposit A: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, click Save, and close the New Line window. Open the Finance tab and click Add Deposit; in Create Deposit pick a Payment Method and type 41.00 in Deposit Amount, then click Record Deposit. Open the Lines tab and click New Line; in the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 1.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Leave Invoice Date as today, click Create Invoice, and reload the page (F5) when the New Customer Payment window opens. The invoice is paid from the deposit, and the rest, 40.00, stays as an unused deposit dated today.

715426.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose custom role has "Reports" in the Page Access card, "Work orders → View", "Part sales → View" (under the Parts Department switch) but not "Invoicing & payments → View".
  • Have a customer with an overdue work order invoice A and an overdue part sale invoice B, both made at your current location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with that customer's group expanded.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make work order invoice A: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 300.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type the date 45 days before today in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  4. Make part sale invoice B: Click Parts in the top bar, then Part Sales in the left menu, then New Part Sale; pick customer A in Customer and click Save. Click Add Part: leave Part Number empty, type a Description, 1 in Quantity and a Cost, then click Save & Close; on the part's row type 300.00 in the Sell Price box. Click Authorize if it shows. On the part's row pick any Vendor and click Order (the status reads Awaiting), then click Receive on the row; in the Receive parts window type a part number in the empty box above the part's description, a Vendor Invoice Number, tick the part and click Receive Parts (1) (the status reads Received). Open the Finance tab, type the date 45 days before today in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice; reload the page (F5) when the New Customer Payment window opens.
  5. Make the role for this test: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role. In "Choose a template" click Skip (every switch then starts off). Type a Role Name, then switch on "Reports" in the Page Access card, tick View in the "Work orders" card, switch on Parts Department and tick View in "Part sales", and leave "Invoicing & payments" unticked, then click Create.
  6. Sign in with that role: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Staff in the left menu. On the row "Tech ShopView" click the edit icon; in Edit Staff Member pick the new role in Role and click Save & Close. Then click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Logout, and on the QA site's sign-in page click Tech in the quick login panel. After the test, sign in as Admin again and set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type a new Name for customer A, type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  4. Make the role for this test: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role. In "Choose a template" click Skip (every switch then starts off). Type a Role Name, then switch on "Reports" in the Page Access card and leave the Customers card unticked, then click Create.
  5. Sign in with that role: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Staff in the left menu. On the row "Tech ShopView" click the edit icon; in Edit Staff Member pick the new role in Role and click Save & Close. Then click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Logout, and on the QA site's sign-in page click Tech in the quick login panel. After the test, sign in as Admin again and set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician.

715481.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a credit memo.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Locations to use: Use "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" as location A (in A to Z order it comes before Lethbridge) and "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" as location B. Start at location A: if the top bar shows another location, click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Change Location, then "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919". To work at location B, switch to "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" the same way, and switch back to "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" when you are done.
  3. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name ZZAUTOTEST Northern Alberta Heavy Haul and Towing Ltd (more than 40 characters), type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  4. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  5. Make invoice 2: While switched to location B (see the Locations to use item): Same way as invoice 1, on customer A's page: Fixed Line Total 200.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  6. Make credit memo 1: On customer A's page open the Invoices tab and click Issue Credit. Type today's date in Credit Date, type 50.00 in Amount, click Issue Store Credit (not Issue Refund), type a Reason, then click Issue Credit.

Preconditions

  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in dark theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Leave the report with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab, also in dark theme, for comparison.

Setup

  1. Locations to use: Use "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" as location A (in A to Z order it comes before Lethbridge) and "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" as location B. Start at location A: if the top bar shows another location, click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Change Location, then "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919". To work at location B, switch to "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" the same way, and switch back to "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" when you are done.
  2. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, then Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type the Name ZZAUTOTEST Northern Alberta Heavy Haul and Towing Ltd (more than 40 characters), pick Credit Terms "Net 30" and Taxes "Exempt (0%)", then click Save & Close.
  3. Make bill 1: Click Parts in the top bar, then Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO. Pick vendor A in Vendor. In Part Number type a new part number and click "Add new special order part: …"; type a Description, 1 in Quantity and 300.00 in Cost; click Add, then Save & Close. In the Purchase Orders list click Receive on that order (Vendor column: vendor A); type a Vendor Invoice # (for example bill 1), type today's date in Invoice Date, type 0 in Tax, then click Receive Parts (1).
  4. Make bill 2: While switched to location B (see the Locations to use item): Same way as bill 1, with vendor A in Vendor: Cost 200.00; type today's date in Invoice Date.
  5. Make vendor credit 1: Click Parts in the top bar, then Returns in the left menu, then Create Return. Pick vendor A in Vendor, type a Packaging Slip, pick the part received on bill 1 in Part Number, type 50.00 in Price Per Unit, then click Save Return. In the Returns list tick that return and click Receive Credit; type a Credit Memo Number, type today's date in Credit Date, type 0 in Tax, then click Post Credit.

Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.

715557.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on, so the credit term shows.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with a long name, an overdue invoice, a phone number and a credit term.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design picture "Call list on A/R Collection" (ar-ap-p7-call-list-on-a-r-collection.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name ZZAUTOTEST Northern Alberta Heavy Haul and Towing Ltd (more than 40 characters), type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice 1: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN if the vehicle has none: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type the date 45 days before today in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
